title: Classical frontier restriction data
statement: Fix the finite-field datum D, coefficient prime l and algebraic closure Ω, and the normalized classical realization, system and restriction comparison of [def-zl-classical-lisse-restriction-models; def-zl-classical-lisse-restriction-maps]. The structures RestrictionModel, WeilRestrictionResult and Frontier record respectively an actual locally closed finite-field model factoring through a chosen stratum, a lift of its actual restricted ambient Weil map with a common finite coefficient model and the pinned normalized fibre identification, and a reduced closed frontier chain with its clopen affine smooth geometrically connected pieces. The actual support inclusion, successive-restriction equation and conjunction RestrictionConclusion use the prescribed raw and derived pullback compositors. The data retain the existing definitions verbatim and live separately from the assembly theorem so its argument steps can import them without a cycle.

Existing Sheaf.Paper.ClassicalSystemRawLisseRealization is existential in its realization family; it does not directly supply the uniform conclusion for the given R,S,A,C. Existing Sheaf.DeligneLaumon.SmoothAffineFrontierStratification supplies the geometric diagram, requiring scheme-theoretic reduction and canonical-associativity glue. No duplicate of the three assembly lemmas.
